Please analyze these stocks using our Marcus strategy (you'll find the skill documentation at /root/.openclaw/workspace/skills/marcus-investment-analyst/SKILL.md) and produce a file called investment_report.json in the /workspace directory.

The report should include:
1. A buy/hold/sell signal for each stock in the snapshot, based on our proprietary entry and exit rules
2. The recommended position allocation percentage for any stocks that receive a buy signal
3. The chan theory (缠论) analysis results for any stocks that qualify
4. Any stocks that should be excluded from consideration, and why

Our committee wants to see that the correct strategy parameters have been applied — not generic rules. Please make sure to use the actual analysis scripts where appropriate.
